description: Calculate reduced-mass Rydberg vacuum and standard-air wavelengths, level energies and ionization energies for H, D or a one-electron ion. Supply integer lower and upper levels; custom ions need Z and a bare nuclear mass in kg. Air uses Edlen (1966), dry air at 15 C and 101325 Pa, from 300 to 1700 nm; fine structure and Lamb shifts are excluded.

n_upper.description: Upper principal quantum number, integer > n_lower and <= 10000.

nuclear_mass_kg.description: Bare nuclear mass in kg, required for ion.

species.description: H, D or ion; default H.

z.description: Integer nuclear charge 1 to 20, required for ion.

name: hydrogen_spectrum
title: Hydrogen and Rydberg spectrum
